identity.title: Hermes Version Banner Preflight Parser Correction
identity.objective: Correct only the Hermes version-output parser so the existing fail-closed controller extracts package version 0.21.3 from the exact branded Hermes Agent v0.21.3 (2026.9.14) banner, never mistakes the release date for version authority, preserves the branded legacy hermes-agent 0.21.3 form and bytes decoding, rejects wrong, malformed, release-date-only, and unbranded version text, and leaves all invocation, managed-profile, provider/model, Firecrawl, retry, usage, schema, safety, cost, authority, and request/receipt contracts unchanged.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP175J. The branded package-version parser, its focused acceptance/rejection tests, WP175J package records, and narrow current-truth updates are removed. The pre-WP175J generic first-semver parser returns; no controller, runner, managed config, policy identity, request/receipt schema, dependency, workflow, credential, provider, Firecrawl, order, Gate-C, Alpha, or live state exists to unwind.
